China removes military officials and ex-Politburo member in Xi's purge

China has removed six top military officers and a former Politburo member from their legislative posts as part of President Xi Jinping's ongoing anti-corruption campaign. The purge targets the nation's political and military elite. This action signals a continued consolidation of power by President Xi.
